info.description:
## AI RAG Microservice Collection (Verified 200 OK)

**Base URL:** `https://sih2026-86kl.onrender.com`

All 5 verified microservice endpoints:
1. GET `/health` — Service & Database Health
2. POST `/api/ai/tender/process` — Tender PDF Ingestion & Embeddings
3. POST `/api/ai/bidder/process` — Bidder PDF Ingestion & Embeddings
4. POST `/api/ai/bidder-tender-chat/ask` — Single-Bidder Evaluation Chatbot
5. POST `/api/ai/compare/chat` — Multi-Bidder 'Compare with AI' Chatbot

request.description: Check whether AI RAG microservice is running.
Downloads PDF from Cloudinary, chunks text, generates embeddings, and saves into tender_embeddings.
Downloads bidder PDF, generates vector embeddings, and stores into bidder_embeddings.
Single-Bidder Evaluation Chatbot. Retrieves tender + bidder + ML context and generates Gemini response with citations.
Compare with AI — Multi-Bidder Chatbot API. Compares shortlisted bidders against tender requirements using Tender RAG, Bidder RAG, and ML summary evidence.
